title: Tenure Share When a Duplicate Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Payment Is Re-Settled
content:
When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim carrying a duplicate payment is re-settled, the deductible subtracted is multiplied by the duplicate re-settlement's tenure share, read from the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

| Move-in date before the loss date | Rent payment reversal on the rental's ledger in the 12 whole months before the handling date | Tenure share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 60 whole months or more | none | 0.5 |
| at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months | none | 0.75 |
| otherwise | — | 1 |

In words: the duplicate re-settlement's tenure share is 0.5 when the covered rental's move-in date is 60 or more whole months before the loss date and the rental's ledger shows no rent payment reversal in the 12 whole months before the handling date, 0.75 when the move-in date is at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months before the loss date and the ledger shows no such reversal, and 1 otherwise.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A tenant 30 whole months from move-in at the loss date with a clean ledger: 0.75, so a deductible of 260.00 becomes 195.00.
